findings.quote: Section $12$ protects silence and counsel during **custodial investigation**. This is police questioning of a suspect who is held or whose freedom to act is greatly limited. Under RA 7438, it also includes police invitations to question someone about an offense they are suspected of committing. These safeguards do not apply to every general inquiry. Section $17$ separately protects against forced testimony against oneself.

lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.quote: The accused may be heard personally and through **counsel**, a lawyer.
lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.note: The dense catalogue was replaced with short definitions and explanations of each trial right.

lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.quote: There must be invasion or rebellion, and public safety must require suspension.
lesson-philippine-constitution-bill-of-r.note: Both constitutional conditions for suspension are explicitly taught and applied.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A charge is a claim that a crime was committed.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Innocence is explained through the difference between a charge and proof and applied in example 1.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: This protects the chance to answer the charge and present a defense.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Counsel and personal hearing are explained and applied to a court barring both responses.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: This means knowing the crime charged and the acts claimed to make up that crime.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Notice of the accusation is explained and applied to a hidden-charge scenario.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Speedy means it must move forward without unreasonable delay.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Speed, impartiality, and public access receive meanings, limitations, and worked applications.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: This lets the defense question people who testify against the accused and test what they say.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Confrontation is connected to questioning and applied to the blocked witness examination.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: It helps the defense obtain needed proof even when a witness will not attend willingly.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Court orders for defense witnesses and records are explained and applied.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: An emergency label is not enough.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Invasion or rebellion plus public safety is taught and convenience is rejected in a worked case.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: Speedy disposition is broader and also reaches cases before these other bodies.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Judicial, quasi-judicial, and administrative coverage is explained with an agency-case application.

general-information-philippine-constitut.quote: A forced spoken answer or written admission can be testimonial evidence.
general-information-philippine-constitut.note: Compelled self-incrimination is explained with scope limits and a forced-written-admission example.
